howToPlay: Use Fang's basic attack from a distance to chip away at enemies. Once a target is weak, use his Super to close the gap and finish them off with follow-up strikes.
gears: Equip SHIELD to improve survivability while diving into combat, and DAMAGE to ensure successful takedowns when health is low.
trait: This assassin is ideal for players who prefer aggressive, high-risk playstyles that focus on quick bursts of damage and momentum-based chaining.
